name: Getchu Ya★Getchu!!
source:
Comu-chan worked with her rival to solve the case about the stolen prize, and her efforts were recognized by the Akiba Kingdom. Finally Comu-chan becomes manager of her own cute Getchu store! In order to win National Founding Festival and enliven this kingdom she must work hard with Mike and outpace all the rivals.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
小萌与竞争对手合作，解决了头奖失窃的案件，她的努力也得到了秋叶原王国的认可。终于，小萌成为了自己可爱店铺“Getchu”的店长！为了赢得建国纪念祭、让王国重新热闹起来，她必须与阿迈一起努力，超越所有竞争对手。

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]）
